Cache discount description: Cached input is billed at the lower cache price when the model supports it; actual savings depend on model pricing.
Cache hit rate is the share of prompt in: Cache hit rate is the share of prompt input tokens served from the prompt cache. Higher means cheaper and faster.
Coding cache is the share of cacheable t: Coding cache is the share of cacheable tokens written to the cache (5m/1h creation). Coding workloads reuse context heavily, so a healthy creation share keeps future hits high.
Performance metrics for the latest 100 r: Performance metrics for the latest 100 records
Real-time availability and latency for y: Real-time availability and latency for your usable groups.
The reference cache rate marks the healt: The reference cache rate marks the healthy level for this gateway. Groups below it are highlighted.
